questions.q: Which king unified Nepal in the 18th century?
questions.why: He took the Kathmandu Valley in 1768.

questions.q: In which year did Nepal become a republic?
questions.why: The monarchy was abolished in May 2008.

questions.q: In which Nepali town was the Buddha born?
questions.why: Emperor Ashoka put up a pillar there.

questions.q: Which earthquake devastated Nepal in April 2015?
questions.why: It killed nearly 9,000 people.

questions.q: Who first reached the summit of Everest, in 1953?
questions.why: They reached the top on 29 May 1953.

questions.q: Which Nepali soldiers have long served in the British and Indian armies?
questions.why: Their curved knife is the khukuri.

questions.q: Which family of hereditary prime ministers ruled Nepal from 1846 to 1951?
questions.why: Jung Bahadur Rana founded the line.

questions.q: Which dynasty built many temples in the Kathmandu Valley's Durbar Squares?
questions.why: Malla kings ruled from the 12th to the 18th century.

questions.q: Which 1816 treaty ended the Anglo-Nepalese War?
questions.why: Nepal lost land in the west and south.

questions.q: In which year did the royal massacre at Narayanhiti Palace happen?
questions.why: King Birendra and much of his family were killed.

questions.q: Which king helped end Rana rule and bring democracy in 1951?
questions.why: Kathmandu's airport is named after him.

questions.q: In which year was Nepal's current constitution adopted?
questions.why: It made Nepal a federal republic.

questions.q: Which ancient valley city is called the 'City of Devotees'?
questions.why: Its Durbar Square has the 55-Window Palace.

questions.q: Which temple has Nepal's oldest dated inscription, from AD 464?
questions.why: King Manadeva set it up.

questions.q: Who was Nepal's last king?
questions.why: He reigned until 2008.

questions.q: Which Nepali princess married the Tibetan king Songtsen Gampo?
questions.why: She is said to have taken Buddhist images to Tibet.

questions.q: In which valley is Nepal's capital?
questions.why: It also holds Patan and Bhaktapur.

questions.q: Which lakeside city is the gateway to the Annapurna mountains?
questions.why: It sits on Phewa Lake.

questions.q: Which national park is most famous for its one-horned rhinos?
questions.why: It was Nepal's first national park, in 1973.

questions.q: Which two countries border Nepal?
questions.why: Nepal is landlocked.

questions.q: How many of the world's ten highest mountains are in Nepal?
questions.why: Including Everest and Kangchenjunga.

questions.q: What is Mount Everest called in Nepali?
questions.why: Chomolungma is its Tibetan name.

questions.q: What are the lowland plains of southern Nepal called?
questions.why: They are hot, flat and farmed.

questions.q: Which is the world's third-highest mountain, on the Nepal–India border?
questions.why: It is 8,586 m high.

questions.q: Which was the first 8,000 m mountain ever climbed, in 1950?
questions.why: A French team led by Maurice Herzog climbed it.

questions.q: What is Nepal's largest lake?
questions.why: It is in remote Mugu district.

questions.q: What is Nepal's longest river?
questions.why: It rises in Tibet.

questions.q: Which river flows past the Pashupatinath temple?
questions.why: Cremations take place on its banks there.

questions.q: How many provinces does Nepal have?
questions.why: They were created by the 2015 constitution.

questions.q: Which lake near Manang is one of the highest lakes of its size in the world?
questions.why: It lies at about 4,900 m.

questions.q: Which is Nepal's deepest lake?
questions.why: It is famous for its turquoise water.

questions.q: Which peak overlooking Pokhara has never officially been climbed to the top?
questions.why: It is sacred and closed to climbers.

questions.q: Which sport was declared Nepal's national sport in 2017?
questions.why: Dandi biyo had long been seen as the national game.

questions.q: Which Nepali leg-spinner became the first from Nepal to play in the IPL?
questions.why: He played for Delhi in 2018.

questions.q: Which climber, 'Nimsdai', climbed all 14 eight-thousanders in about six months?
questions.why: He did it in 2019.

questions.q: Which Sherpa holds the record for the most Everest summits?
questions.why: He has summited over 30 times.

questions.q: Who captained Nepal's cricket team during its rise from 2009 to 2019?
questions.why: He scored Nepal's first ODI century.

questions.q: Which traditional Nepali game is played with a long stick and a short one?
questions.why: It is like gilli-danda in India.

questions.q: Which Kathmandu stadium is Nepal's main football ground?
questions.why: It is named after the martyr Dasharath Chand.

questions.q: In which year did Nepal gain ODI status?
questions.why: They played their first ODI against the Netherlands.

questions.q: At the 2023 Asian Games, Nepal scored a record 314 in a T20 against which team?
questions.why: It was the first T20 international total over 300.

questions.q: Who hit a nine-ball fifty in that record match?
questions.why: Kushal Malla hit a 34-ball century in the same innings.

questions.q: Which cricket ground in Kirtipur is Nepal's main venue?
questions.why: Fans watch from the grassy slopes.

questions.q: Which franchise T20 league did Nepal launch in 2024?
questions.why: Eight teams took part in the first season.

questions.q: Kushal Malla's 2023 century against Mongolia came off how many balls?
questions.why: It was then the fastest T20 international hundred.

questions.q: Who was the first Nepali woman to climb Everest, in 1993?
questions.why: She died on the way down and is a national hero.

questions.q: Which Nepali woman has climbed Everest more times than any other woman?
questions.why: She has summited ten times.

questions.q: At which Olympics did Nepal first compete?
questions.why: It was the first Olympics held in Asia.

questions.q: Who wrote the much-loved Nepali poem 'Muna Madan'?
questions.why: He is called 'Mahakavi', the great poet.

questions.q: Which 'Adikavi' translated the Ramayana into Nepali?
questions.why: His birthday is celebrated as Bhanu Jayanti.

questions.q: What is Nepal's Kathmandu-based film industry nicknamed?
questions.why: K is for Kathmandu.

questions.q: Which singer is called 'Swar Samrat', the emperor of voice?
questions.why: He sang hundreds of modern Nepali songs.

questions.q: Which Buddhist nun is internationally famous for her singing?
questions.why: She uses her earnings for girls' education.

questions.q: 'Resham Firiri' is a famous Nepali what?
questions.why: It is about the heart fluttering like silk in the wind.

questions.q: Which hand drum is central to Nepali folk music?
questions.why: It is played on both ends.

questions.q: What is 'lok dohori'?
questions.a: A sung contest between two sides
questions.why: Singers trade witty verses back and forth.

questions.q: Who wrote the novel 'Shirishko Phool' ('The Blue Mimosa')?
questions.why: It won the Madan Puraskar in 1965.

questions.q: Which singer was called the 'Nightingale of the Hills'?
questions.why: She came from Darjeeling.

questions.q: Which folk-rock band is led by Amrit Gurung?
questions.why: It formed in 1990.

questions.q: Which bowed folk fiddle is traditionally played by the Gandharva community?
questions.why: Gandharvas were wandering musicians who carried news.

questions.q: Which 2016 Nepali film by Deepak Rauniyar premiered at the Venice Film Festival?
questions.why: It is set after the civil war.

questions.q: Which 2012 heist film by Nischal Basnet helped revive Nepali cinema?
questions.why: It was a surprise box-office hit.

questions.q: Which Oscar-nominated 1999 film was shot in Nepal's Dolpo region?
questions.why: Eric Valli directed it with local cast members.

questions.q: Which former Prime Minister also wrote the novel 'Sumnima'?
questions.why: He was Nepal's first elected Prime Minister.

questions.q: Which is Nepal's biggest Hindu festival, lasting about 15 days?
questions.why: Elders give tika and blessings.

questions.q: Which festival of lights honours crows, dogs and cows?
questions.why: It lasts five days.

questions.q: What are Nepal's famous steamed dumplings called?
questions.why: They came with Newar traders from Tibet.

questions.q: Which meal of lentil soup and rice is Nepal's everyday staple?
questions.why: Many Nepalis eat it twice a day.

questions.q: Which ring-shaped sweet rice bread is made for Tihar?
questions.why: It is deep-fried.

questions.q: During which festival do women wear red and fast for their husbands?
questions.why: They dance and sing at temples.

questions.q: Which great Shiva temple stands on the Bagmati in Kathmandu?
questions.why: It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

questions.q: What is gundruk?
questions.why: It is often made into soup.

questions.q: What is chhurpi?
questions.a: Hard cheese made from yak or cow milk
questions.why: It can be chewed for hours.

questions.q: Which Newar sweet dumpling is eaten at the festival named after it?
questions.why: It is filled with molasses and sesame.

questions.q: Bhaktapur's famous 'king curd' is called what?
questions.why: It is set in clay pots.

questions.q: What is the 'living goddess' of Kathmandu called?
questions.why: She is a young girl chosen from the Newar community.

questions.q: During which Kathmandu festival is the Kumari pulled through the streets in a chariot?
questions.why: It is held in September.

questions.q: Bisket Jatra is the New Year festival of which city?
questions.why: Two giant chariots are pulled in a tug of war.

questions.q: Bara, a fried lentil patty, is a dish of which community?
questions.why: It is sometimes topped with an egg.

questions.q: Which hilltop stupa in Kathmandu is nicknamed the 'Monkey Temple'?
questions.why: Monkeys live on the hill.

questions.q: What is unusual about Nepal's flag?
questions.a: It is made of two stacked triangles
questions.why: It is the only national flag that is not rectangular.

questions.q: What is Nepal's currency?
questions.why: It is pegged to the Indian rupee.

questions.q: What is Nepal's national animal?
questions.why: The cow is sacred in Hinduism.

questions.q: What is Nepal's national flower?
questions.why: It is called lali gurans.

questions.q: What is Nepal's official language?
questions.why: Over 120 languages are spoken in Nepal.

questions.q: What is Nepal's national bird?
questions.why: It is called danphe.

questions.q: Which giant stupa in Kathmandu is one of the largest in the world?
questions.why: It is a centre of Tibetan Buddhism.

questions.q: Nepal Standard Time is how far ahead of UTC?
questions.why: It is one of the few time zones with a 45-minute offset.

questions.q: Which UNESCO World Heritage Site is made of seven monument zones?
questions.why: It includes the three Durbar Squares.

questions.q: What is Nepal's national anthem?
questions.why: It means 'Made of hundreds of flowers'.

questions.q: What colour is the border of Nepal's flag?
questions.why: The field is crimson.

questions.q: What is the curved knife of the Gurkhas called?
questions.why: It appears on the Nepal Army's emblem.

questions.q: Which ethnic group from the Everest region is famous for mountain guiding?
questions.why: Sherpa means 'people from the east'.

questions.q: In which year did Nepal join the United Nations?
questions.why: It joined with several other countries that December.

questions.q: Which sacred high-altitude lake is a pilgrimage site for Janai Purnima?
questions.why: It lies at about 4,380 m in Langtang.

questions.q: What is Gorkhapatra, first published in 1901?
questions.why: It is still published today.
